subject: Air freight quote request to EZE
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Could you please quote the fastest air freight option to EZE (Buenos Aires, AR) for a shipment of automotive sensors? Please arrange truck pickup from our site in 24489 (Kiel), Germany, and onward transport to the departure airport. The shipment will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-26.

The consignment consists of 7 pieces, with a gross weight of 859 kg and a total volume of 3.50 cbm.

Please provide an all-in price in EUR, including the truck pickup, and confirm the earliest available pickup and expected arrival at EZE.

Mit freundlichen Gruessen / Kind regards
Jonas Kessler
Logistics Coordinator
Kessler Feinmechanik GmbH, Ulm
